text: Yesterday, I went to We Care Clinic. The service was excellent. The doctor gave me excellent advice. I had a nose job. The first time I had it done in Bangkok, it didn't go well. The second time I went to the same place, hoping it would be better. I was not satisfied after the third time, so I came to We Care Pattaya. Judging from the service and the doctor, it's very good. It's much different from before. They offer a wide variety of medicines. They even gave me two cute ice balloons to use as a cold compress and blocked my nose. It was very good. Let me tell you about the staff. That day, I really didn't have enough money. I had money on my card, but it wouldn't work. I don't know why. Then, when it was time to pay, I was 10 baht short. The staff lent me a tip. The staff were very kind. I'll have to give them a tip when I go clean my wound and then I'll come back to review it. Thank you, doctor, for your new nose.

restaurant_name: วีแคร์คลินิคพัทยา สำนักงานใหญ่ พัทยากลาง
text: #Crooked, Asymmetrical, Disappointing. The clinic is clean but terrible. The staff is okay, but I don't know how they do things. They don't tell patients that the result will be crooked or asymmetrical. After the procedure, they show a document proving that the nasal base was already crooked. Why didn't they tell me beforehand or ask for my approval? The result is crooked, with a high, dam-like bridge, a drooping tip, and a hump, but they didn't inform me whether I wanted it corrected or not. They just shoved the silicone in, finished in 20 minutes. I looked in the mirror and thought, "Beautiful!" But as the wound healed and the silicone started to settle, it became even more crooked. I went to see the doctor, and he said it wasn't crooked. The assistant nurse also said it wasn't crooked. What does that even mean? My nose is clearly crooked, and one side of the tip is sunken. They said the soft tissue might have collapsed and suggested some kind of injection to fix it, but they refused. They told me to adjust it at home—my nose is crooked, and they want me to spend all day adjusting it? I've been to the doctor almost every month, 3-4 times, even before my warranty expired. It's been almost a year since the procedure on October 7th, and it's even worse now. Completely unethical. I'm sharing my experience for those considering We Care Clinic, Pattaya Central branch. Many people who went there had crooked results. Why is the clinic so irresponsible? You can choose your own silicone implant, but they didn't tell me my base wasn't good beforehand. Now that it's done, I can't go back. If you want to see pictures, message me. It's very crooked. #CrookedNose #WeCareClinic #WeCareClinic (Apologies for any typos.)
